title: Analyst Recommendations
description: Wall Street analyst recommendations and price targets. Data from FMP + yfinance, refreshed hourly. Stocks only.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'analyst_strong_buy'), 0)
       + COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'analyst_buy'), 0)
       > COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'analyst_hold'), 0)
       + COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'analyst_sell'), 0)
       + COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'analyst_strong_sell'), 0)
    THEN 'BUY'
    WHEN COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'analyst_hold'), 0)
       > COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'analyst_strong_buy'), 0)
       + COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'analyst_buy'), 0)
       + COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'analyst_sell'), 0)
       + COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'analyst_strong_sell'), 0)
    THEN 'HOLD'
    ELSE 'SELL'
  END AS recommendation
FROM fundamentals
WHERE symbol = 'NVDA'
  AND metric IN ('analyst_strong_buy','analyst_buy','analyst_hold','analyst_sell','analyst_strong_sell')
  AND time > NOW() - INTERVAL '25 hours'

panels.title: Analyst Recommendation Breakdown
panels.description: Number of Wall Street analysts recommending each rating. Stacked per symbol.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  symbol,
  COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'analyst_strong_buy'),  0) AS "Strong Buy",
  COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'analyst_buy'),         0) AS "Buy",
  COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'analyst_hold'),        0) AS "Hold",
  COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'analyst_sell'),        0) AS "Sell",
  COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'analyst_strong_sell'), 0) AS "Strong Sell"
FROM fundamentals
WHERE metric IN ('analyst_strong_buy','analyst_buy','analyst_hold','analyst_sell','analyst_strong_sell')
  AND time > NOW() - INTERVAL '25 hours'
GROUP BY symbol
ORDER BY symbol

panels.title: Price Targets vs Current Price
panels.description: Target Δ shows how the consensus target has moved since yesterday. ↑ = raised, ↓ = lowered, → = unchanged.

targets.rawSql:
WITH current AS (
  SELECT symbol, metric, value
  FROM fundamentals
  WHERE metric IN ('price','price_target_consensus','price_target_high','price_target_low')
    AND time > NOW() - INTERVAL '25 hours'
),
prev AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (symbol) symbol, value AS prev_consensus
  FROM fundamentals
  WHERE metric = 'price_target_consensus'
    AND time < NOW() - INTERVAL '20 hours'
  ORDER BY symbol, time DESC
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    c.symbol,
    ROUND(MAX(c.value) FILTER (WHERE c.metric = 'price')::numeric, 2)                  AS current_price,
    ROUND(MAX(c.value) FILTER (WHERE c.metric = 'price_target_consensus')::numeric, 2) AS consensus,
    ROUND(MAX(c.value) FILTER (WHERE c.metric = 'price_target_high')::numeric, 2)      AS target_high,
    ROUND(MAX(c.value) FILTER (WHERE c.metric = 'price_target_low')::numeric, 2)       AS target_low,
    p.prev_consensus
  FROM current c
  LEFT JOIN prev p ON c.symbol = p.symbol
  GROUP BY c.symbol, p.prev_consensus
  HAVING MAX(c.value) FILTER (WHERE c.metric = 'price') IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  symbol                                                                          AS "Symbol",
  current_price                                                                   AS "Current Price",
  consensus                                                                       AS "Consensus Target",
  target_high                                                                     AS "Target High",
  target_low                                                                      AS "Target Low",
  ROUND(((consensus - current_price) / NULLIF(current_price, 0) * 100)::numeric, 1) AS "Upside %",
  CASE
    WHEN prev_consensus IS NULL                   THEN '—'
    WHEN consensus - prev_consensus  >  0.01
      THEN '↑ +$' || to_char((consensus - prev_consensus)::numeric,  'FM999990.00')
    WHEN consensus - prev_consensus  < -0.01
      THEN '↓ -$' || to_char((prev_consensus - consensus)::numeric,  'FM999990.00')
    ELSE '→ unchanged'
  END                                                                             AS "Target Δ"
FROM agg
ORDER BY "Upside %" DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Consensus Price Target — 30-Day Trend
panels.description: How the analyst consensus price target has drifted over time. A rising line means analysts are collectively raising their outlook.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket('1 hour', time) AS time,
  symbol AS metric,
  MAX(value) AS value
FROM fundamentals
WHERE metric = 'price_target_consensus'
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Upgrades & Downgrades
panels.description: Individual analyst firm grade changes. Adjust the time range picker to control how far back you see. New rows appear within 1 hour of being published.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  grade_date                                                    AS "Date",
  symbol                                                        AS "Symbol",
  COALESCE(firm, 'Unknown')                                     AS "Firm",
  COALESCE(from_grade, '—')                                     AS "From",
  to_grade                                                      AS "To Grade",
  CASE action
    WHEN 'up'   THEN 'Upgrade'
    WHEN 'down' THEN 'Downgrade'
    WHEN 'init' THEN 'Initiation'
    WHEN 'main' THEN 'Maintained'
    WHEN 'reit' THEN 'Reiterated'
    ELSE COALESCE(action, '—')
  END AS "Action"
FROM analyst_grades
WHERE $__timeFilter(grade_date)
ORDER BY grade_date DESC
LIMIT 200
